items.title: Ray Lopez Interview, 1958-08-30
items.q: Gus Miller and I got into a little string band deal

ctx.x: Okay, to answer that, then, do you want to stop? Okay, let's see, you were talking about when you first started on your carnet. Yeah. You told about that Italian wedding. Mm-hmm. And you heard other tunes.
Yeah, and then we... Well, little by little, we got into Miller, Gus Miller and I got into a little string band deal, you know?
